text:
mira: Quick design sprint feedback 11 — opening a thread for the vectors preview + batch export changes. Main asks: 1) toolbar focus order in list view, 2) CSV header names & order, 3) screen reader hints for exported files. Figma ref: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/vectors-preview (frame: preview-row-toolbar + export-modal)

devin: looked through it. two quick things: CSV currently puts 'vector' first which pushes human-readable fields later. I'd prefer human fields first (id, text, source) then vector columns.

rachel: accessibility nit: when keyboarding into the row, focus lands on the checkbox, then skip to actions in the far right. users need a predictable local toolbar right after the row title. we use roving tabindex in other lists 1. can we match that pattern?

tom: small UI suggestion: collapse less-used toolbar icons under a "more" kebab to reduce tab stops. but ensure the kebab has accessible label e.g., "More row actions for <title>".

aria-bot: Accessibility scan results: 4 issues found. Missing aria-labels on inline icon buttons (3 items), export modal lacks aria-live feedback, CSV header order does not match table DOM order. Recommendations: add aria-labels, reorder DOM to match visual order or use aria-colindex for screen readers, add aria-live region announcing export progress/completion.

mira: great. also let's standardize CSV header keys to stable names for easy re-import. Proposal: 
- id
- text
- source
- created_at
- metadata_tags
- vector_0..vector_n (batched)
- norm (optional)
- rerank_score (if present)

devin: +1 on stable keys. For vector columns, prefer prefix 'vec_' rather than 'vector' to avoid conflicts. e.g., vec_0, vec_1...

rachel: UX copy: export modal title should be "Export rows (CSV)" and include a short sentence: "Headers are stable keys for re-import." Add a link "How to re-import" to docs. For SR users, the modal should announce estimated size (e.g., "Exporting 1,234 rows, ~4.2MB").

tom: implementation detail: if we defer vector expansion (i.e., store as base64 blob per row) we can offer two modes: "Flat CSV (vectors as columns)" and "Blob CSV (vector base64)". Both need clear labels and examples.

aria-bot: Suggested CSV header pattern (left-to-right visual order): ["id","text","source","created_at","metadata_tags","vec_0","vec_1","vec_2","vec_3","norm","rerank_score"]
Note: use stable column names and consistent ordering for deterministic diffs.

mira: ok next steps: rachel/tom pair to prototype keyboard + kebab approach. devin will update export API to output vec_ prefix and stable headers. I'll update modal copy and add aria-live messages.

devin: I'll also add a tiny sample import script in docs showing mapping of metadata_tags to app fields.

rachel: ping when prototype available. I'll run VoiceOver checks on the modal and row nav.

mira: thanks all 1 :rocket:
